text_pointers.first_1500_characters:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered as follows:

Executive Order 12019 of November 3, 1977 (Establishing the Defense Meritorious Service Medal), is amended by inserting ", or to any member of the armed forces of a friendly foreign nation," after "any member of the Armed Forces of the United States".

BARACK OBAMA

The White House,

April 18, 2014.

Executive Order 13666 of April 18, 2014 
Expanding Eligibility for the Defense Meritorious Service 
Medal 
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the 
laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered as follows: 
Executive Order 12019 of November 3, 1977 (Establishing the Defense Meri-
torious Service Medal), is amended by inserting ‘‘, or to any member of 
the armed forces of a friendly foreign nation,’’ after ‘‘any member of the 
Armed Forces of the United States’’. 
THE WHITE HOUSE, 
April 18, 2014. 
[FR Doc. 2014–09343 
Filed 4–22–14; 8:45 am]
